reader_question: How widely do uninsured rates vary among counties in each region?
grade_line: Documented: the Census Bureau’s Small Area Health Insurance Estimates
title: Counties in the South had the highest median uninsured rate of the four regions in 2024, 13.9 percent of people under 65, by the Census Bureau’s estimates.
measure_line: Share of people under 65 without health insurance in each county, 2024, by Census region, 50 states and DC. Each box spans the middle half of a region’s counties; the whiskers reach the last county within one and a half times that span, and open circles mark the counties beyond it.
reading_guide: The line in each box is the median county. In the South, the middle half of counties ran from 11.0 to 17.9 percent.
notes: Each county counts once, whatever its population, so a small county weighs as much as a large one. Kalawao County, Hawaii, has no estimate, so the chart leaves it out.
Method: the Census Bureau’s model combines survey answers with administrative records to estimate each county’s rate; small counties carry wide margins of error, so the chart ranks no county.
All 62 counties past a whisker sit above their region’s box, with estimates up to 42.5 percent.
source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Small Area Health Insurance Estimates, people under 65 without health insurance, 2024, counties in the 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Model-based estimates; small counties carry wide margins of error; each region’s quartiles, whiskers and outliers computed by Oath & Action.
alt: Box plots of county uninsured rates for people under 65 in 2024, one row per Census region. The median county runs from 7.2 percent in the Northeast to 13.9 percent in the South, whose middle half spans 11.0 to 17.9 percent, the widest of the four; 62 counties sit above their region’s whiskers.

table.caption: County uninsured rates by Census region, people under 65, 2024, percent

chart_notes: The South’s box takes the dark ink; the other regions’ boxes are light gray, each with its median as a dark line. Small open circles mark the counties past a whisker.

labels.axis: Percent of people under 65 without health insurance

notes_internal: Maker B, round 2. Data plan row 56, rule 14.60. R2-2: drawn from the derived summaries census-sahie-county-uninsured-box-by-region and census-sahie-county-uninsured-outliers (maker_b_round2_derive.py, from P7-027), Tukey’s box by the data lead’s ruling (g).
